'''Keelkana''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of aquatic, eel-like creatures that were native to the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. They grew to be several meters long, and were employed as mounts by the [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]]. They saw much use during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]] that was fought in the opening months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when they bit through the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and war vehicles of the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]]. During the same battle, the combined strength of several keelkana was used by a team of Knights to push a giant [[crab cannon]] to its destruction in a deep trench carved into the ocean floor.
